name: Maniatic Launcher
blurb: A launcher for the decompilation of Retro Engine v5, used in Sonic Mania Plus.
description:
A launcher for the decompilation of Retro Engine v5, used in Sonic Mania Plus.
It allows to run this game natively, and facilitates the installation and development
of mods.

To play this decompilation, you neeed to own a Steam copy of Sonic Mania (or Plus).

This software is distributed under Fair Use. The Digital Millenium Copyright Act of 1998, in Section 103(f)(3) regarding Reverse Engineering states:

The information acquired through the acts permitted under
paragraph (1), and the means permitted under paragraph (2),
may be made available to others if the person referred to in paragraph
(1) or (2), as the case may be, provides such information or means
solely for the purpose of enabling interoperability of an independently
created computer program with other programs, and to the
extent that doing so does not constitute infringement under this
title or violate applicable law other than this section.

This software contains decompiled code from Sonic Mania, made by Sega Corporation and Evening Star,
which was adapted to run natively in Linux-based operating systems. It does not
contain any kind of art (music, graphics) or level layouts from the original game.
As a result, the software does not work unless the user provides their own copy
of Sonic Mania, obtained by their own legal means.
